notes: AI-authored, unreviewed held-out candidates: 10 exact terminology, 10 paraphrases, 10 cross-document and 10 unanswerable (5 unrelated, 5 missing-evidence). Draft only: not frozen, approved, executed or used for model/settings selection. Question targets were reserved separately from development; shared papers and related concepts still require human semantic overlap review. Pins partial prose and original XML versions; full-source review including missing-evidence expectations is pending. Missing-evidence references provide context only and cannot prove absence. Retire/replace any exposed cases that inform tuning before claiming held-out quality.

cases.question: What focal length and approximate magnification are set on the digital microscope during canopy image acquisition?

references.source_section: 3. Methodology > 3.2. Image Acquisition Platform

required_claims: Acquisition uses a 20 mm focal length and approximately 400-fold magnification.
required_qualifications: These are operating settings, distinct from the microscope's adjustable ranges.
forbidden_claims: The operating magnification is 1000-fold just because that is the device maximum.

cases.question: What are the canopy backlight panel dimensions, brightness and color temperature?

references.source_section: 3. Methodology > 3.2. Image Acquisition Platform

required_claims: The panel is 30 by 42 cm, 500 nits and 6500 K.
required_qualifications: These specify the paper's backward-lighting panel.
forbidden_claims: Unreported spectral calibration or illuminance at the specimen.

cases.question: What do ag_dual_rect and ag_composite_obb designate in the canopy experiments?

references.source_section: 3. Methodology > 3.3. Dataset Construction

required_claims: ag_dual_rect uses standard rectangular boxes; ag_composite_obb is the RGB Channel Fusion dataset.
required_qualifications: These are dataset variant names, not distinct independently acquired corpora.
forbidden_claims: ag_dual_rect is the rotated-OBB variant.

cases.question: How is the ResNet-50 final block fine-tuned for OK/NOK heater classification, and for how many epochs?

references.source_section: 3. Proposed Methodology > 3.2. Feature Extraction and Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks > 3.2.2. Approach 2: Pre-Trained CNNs

required_claims: A 1024-neuron fully connected layer precedes a 2-neuron softmax output; training uses 300 epochs.
required_qualifications: These are study settings for ResNet-50.
forbidden_claims: Confusing ResNet-50's 300 epochs with Inception V3's 400.

cases.question: Which MES telegram codes represent OK/NOK and scratches, lack of paint and dents in the heater demonstration?

references.source_section: 3. Proposed Methodology > 3.3. Automation of the Defect Detection Process
3. Proposed Methodology > 3.3. Automation of the Defect Detection Process

required_claims: Status 1 means OK and 2 means NOK; defect-category codes are 1 scratches, 2 lack of paint, 3 dents.
required_qualifications: The telegram targets an existing university MES to simulate industrial messaging; category codes are not the nioBits bitmask itself.
forbidden_claims: Calling this a demonstrated production-line deployment or treating category code 3 as the literal nioBits field.

cases.question: Which TDI sensor model, across-track pixel count and along-track stage count are reported for TDI-DFSM?

references.source_section: 3. Experimental Setup

required_claims: Gpixel GLT5009BSI has 9072 across-track pixels and 256 along-track TDI stages.
required_qualifications: Available sensor stages differ from the chosen count for a particular experiment.
forbidden_claims: Every experiment ran with all 256 stages.

cases.question: What PSL particle size and individual-particle counts are compared between TDI-DFSM and KEYENCE VHX-5000, and what is excluded?

references.source_section: 4. Experimental Results and Discussions > 4.3. Particle Inspection on Non-Patterned Wafer

required_claims: The particles are 0.5 micrometre PSL; both systems count 60 individual particles, excluding four aggregation regions.
required_qualifications: The reported perfect count applies to this comparison, not every possible particle or operating condition.
forbidden_claims: A universal 100% detection guarantee for all submicrometre defects.

cases.question: What Gaussian window size is used for SSIM in the autoencoder study, and how are pixels weighted within it?

references.source_section: 3. Methodology > 3.3. SSIM Loss Function Improvement

required_claims: The window is 11 by 11; pixels nearer its centre have higher weights, decreasing toward the edges.
required_qualifications: Window dimensions are distinct from training patch dimensions.
forbidden_claims: The Gaussian window is the entire 128 by 128 training patch.

cases.question: Which pretrained network supplies LPIPS features, and how are layerwise patch distances combined?

references.source_section: 3. Methodology > 3.4. Combined AW-SSIM and LPIPS Loss for Stage Two of Training

required_claims: LPIPS uses AlexNet features; it averages distances between the two patches' feature vectors across network layers.
required_qualifications: This is a perceptual-loss feature extractor, not the encoder architecture or an independently tested classifier.
forbidden_claims: LPIPS directly averages raw pixel differences without a feature network.

cases.question: How many MVTec AD training/test samples and which complete-image resolution are reported in the autoencoder experiments?

references.source_section: 4. Experimentation

required_claims: There are 1660 training and 714 test samples; images are resized to 512 by 512.
required_qualifications: Complete-image resolution is not the 128 by 128 patch size; counts cover the selected sample types.
forbidden_claims: The 512 by 512 value is the training patch size.

cases.question: Before making extra copies for learning, how many photographs and distinct damaged locations did the aircraft-cover team collect?

references.source_section: 3. Methodology > 3.3. Dataset Construction

required_claims: They collected 438 raw images of 219 defect points under two lighting methods.
required_qualifications: These are pre-augmentation counts, not the final expanded dataset.
forbidden_claims: 438 independent defect points or 1752 raw photographed locations.

cases.question: Do the two pictures attached to one aircraft-cover flaw show the same position, or are they unrelated snapshots?

references.source_section: 3. Methodology > 3.3. Dataset Construction

required_claims: Each defect point has forward- and backward-lighting images that are strictly spatially aligned.
required_qualifications: This is the authors' dataset description, without a quantified alignment error.
forbidden_claims: A numerical registration accuracy or unrelated randomly paired views.

cases.question: What happened when the aircraft-cover team tried subtracting the two views for the extra colour plane instead of averaging them?

references.source_section: 4. Experiments > 4.3. Results and Discussion > 4.3.4. Comparative Analysis of Results

required_claims: Using the difference image as the third channel caused a slight decrease in mAP.
required_qualifications: This is a tested alternative in this study, without an exact decrease in the cited prose.
forbidden_claims: Subtraction improved mAP or a made-up numerical decline.

cases.question: Was the heater turned automatically to show every side, and what hardware did the authors suggest for removing that manual step?

references.source_section: 4. Results and Discussion > 4.1. Dataset Acquisition and Generation

required_claims: The device was steered manually; a robotic arm was proposed for a fully automatic process.
required_qualifications: Proposed automation is not demonstrated automation.
forbidden_claims: The tested system already used a robotic arm for complete surface coverage.

cases.question: Did making the projected bands narrower help the heater dent check, and what change did the test score show?

references.source_section: 4. Results and Discussion > 4.2. Performance of the Defect Detection and Classification Models

required_claims: Thinner stripes improved the dent test accuracy from 98% to 100%, with reduced loss.
required_qualifications: This result is specific to the tested model, dent category and dataset.
forbidden_claims: Every defect category is guaranteed perfectly detectable with thin stripes.

cases.question: Does the heater study's under-one-second decision mean that a whole photograph-and-display cycle took under one second?

references.source_section: 4. Results and Discussion > 4.3. Performance of the Automatic Detection and Classification System
3. Proposed Methodology > 3.3. Automation of the Defect Detection Process

required_claims: Classification takes less than a second after images enter the model; acquisition and display occur at five-second intervals.
required_qualifications: Model-input classification time and acquisition/display intervals are distinct timing boundaries.
forbidden_claims: The entire end-to-end cycle is measured below one second.

cases.question: When photographing the moving test chart for the same 11-millisecond exposure, which camera blurred and which followed the motion?

references.source_section: 4. Experimental Results and Discussions > 4.2. Resolution Target Imaging

required_claims: The area-array sensor produces severe motion blur; the TDI sensor has an advantage for the moving target at matched 11 ms exposure.
required_qualifications: The matched TDI exposure uses 128 stages; this is the USAF target experiment.
forbidden_claims: This proves TDI outperforms every area camera under all imaging conditions.

cases.question: Was the three-minute scan of an eight-inch wafer already achieved, or is it a projected result from faster settings?

references.source_section: 4. Experimental Results and Discussions > 4.3. Particle Inspection on Non-Patterned Wafer

required_claims: Three minutes is a potential production setting with 608 kHz line frequency and 129 mm/s scanning, distinct from the experiment's fixed 23,400 Hz.
required_qualifications: Do not present potential production parameters as measured prototype throughput.
forbidden_claims: The experimental device demonstrated a three-minute eight-inch-wafer scan.

cases.question: Why does the repair model emphasize weave layout for one material but brightness for tiles, nuts and tablets?

references.source_section: 3. Methodology > 3.3. SSIM Loss Function Improvement

required_claims: Carpet uses greater structure weight for weave detail; tile, hazelnut and pill use greater luminance weight for lighting changes.
required_qualifications: The authors selected weights experimentally for those sample types, not through a universal rule.
forbidden_claims: One equal weighting worked best for all materials.

cases.question: In the later learning phase, which error measure gets more emphasis, and why keep a second one concerned with what looks different?

references.source_section: 3. Methodology > 3.4. Combined AW-SSIM and LPIPS Loss for Stage Two of Training

required_claims: AW-SSIM has higher weight and measures local structure/pixel variation; LPIPS adds perceptual sensitivity to visible texture or shape abnormalities.
required_qualifications: The passage gives relative emphasis, not numerical coefficients.
forbidden_claims: LPIPS has the larger weight or both losses perform the same calculation.

cases.question: Which scratch-related limitations are reported for backward canopy illumination and the selected heater classifier?

references.source_section: 4. Experiments > 4.3. Results and Discussion > 4.3.1. Baseline and Dual-Modal Validity Discussion
4. Results and Discussion > 4.2. Performance of the Defect Detection and Classification Models

required_claims: Canopy backward-only scratch AP is 23%, lowering overall mAP.
Heater scratches have the lowest accuracy and higher loss; improvement, including thinner stripes, is suggested.
required_qualifications: AP and classification accuracy are different metrics.
Different tasks and datasets; this is not a common-benchmark performance ranking.

Claiming a head-to-head evaluation on identical data.

cases.question: What changes in reported metrics follow removing canopy attention versus replacing standard SSIM with AW-SSIM in the autoencoder ablation?

references.source_section: 4. Experiments > 4.3. Results and Discussion > 4.3.4. Comparative Analysis of Results
4. Experimentation > 4.2. Ablation Study > 4.2.1. The Influence of AW-SSIM

required_claims: Removing canopy attention leaves mAP50 relatively stable but lowers mAP50-95 by a reported 5.2%.
The autoencoder reports a 4.16% AUROC improvement with AW-SSIM.
required_qualifications: Preserve the authors' percentage wording; do not infer relative versus percentage-point differences without full-table review.
Different tasks and datasets; this is not a common-benchmark performance ranking.
forbidden_claims: One ablation gain is numerically comparable to the other across metrics.
Claiming a head-to-head evaluation on identical data.
